title: I made a demo of a therapy card game where cats have human-sized problems
author: Zandesh
selftext:
I’ve been working on a small project called **Humans Not Included: Meowltdown**.  
  
After a couple of weeks messing around with LUA as a part of my C.S education, it quickly got strange..

It’s a therapy card game where cats have very human problems and receive advice ranging from surprisingly thoughtful to completely unhinged.

For example:

>“Spray the bottle back. Ask how its childhood feels now.”

Or:

>“I got so high on catnip I proposed to a bathmat. It hasn’t answered.”

The current demo is on Windows, with solo + bots and LAN play. AI has been part of the execution of the artwork, so this felt like a fitting place to share it.

I’d love some feedback from people outside my own increasingly cat-shaped brain — especially on the humour, pacing, clarity, or anything that feels awkward.

[https://hwaindustries.itch.io/humans-not-included-meowltdown](https://hwaindustries.itch.io/humans-not-included-meowltdown)

It’s free, and the bathmat is still considering its options.
